vibe_rationale: Curated multi-venue takeover of laneways, churches and lounges with music, cabaret and art, non-profit and community-rooted, though broader and more regional than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Mixed audience with a family program by day and late-night club and cabaret strands, and no published age data, so adult weight is moderate. A partners page, an info email and 28 listed partners (including health-adjacent names) make the route visible, and the Prince's Square hub suits a lounge or recovery space.
